text: Everybody keeps saying you got to prepare for 90 days. If you want to keep your refrigerator running without the grid for 90 days, then what you're going to need is the EcoFlow Delta 3 Classic plus the 220 watt panel. Now, when I was testing the panels, I was getting about 200 watts of power going into my Delta 3 Classic, which is absolutely fantastic because I could keep my fridge running while charging my power bank. And if you didn't have the solar panels, the Delta 3 Classic will keep your fridge running anywhere from 8 to 12 hours, depending on your fridge. Some use a little less power and some require a lot more power. I'm actually going to purchase another 220 watt panel, which you can pair together to plug into your Delta 3 Classic just in case for those cloudy days. Delta 3 Classic is absolutely perfect if you live in an apartment, but if you want to run multiple appliances and you live in a big home, you're definitely going to need something a lot bigger than this.
